acceptance: Each registered assertion must pass; failures/denials and deliberate unsafe diagnostic effects remain outcomes. This is instrument acceptance, not deployment or population C/R/E acceptance.
cost: Count actual local signature checks/hash reads/policy operations; record local elapsed time separately. No tariffs, salaries or production SLA inferred.

coverage.correspondence: declared local realization, no operational isomorphism proved
coverage.M: explicitly allowed lower-value outcome only when chosen/completed
coverage.incomplete: no sufficient route within the registered horizon
coverage.probability_law: designed finite cases; no population probability fitted
coverage.business_value: illustrative process objective; owner calibration pending

private_state: Expected flags and actual-world facts belong only to the evaluator; participant functions receive observations/claims and admitted current policy sources.
credential_policy: Ephemeral fixture signing keys and compact tokens remain in memory; no credential or private key in output.
implementation_profile: STPA four-step synthetic maintenance/supply control analysis and finite context exercise

cases.narrative: Maintenance is admitted with confirmed stop and an available critical-supply backup.
Critical supply has no backup, so maintenance is explicitly deferred while supply continues.
A stop command has no observed application; entry must remain blocked.
Telemetry is unavailable; the controller cannot claim the required equipment state.
The controller has no mandate for actuation or maintenance entry.
A legally allowed maintenance stop needs no critical-supply backup.
The equipment is already confirmed stopped and critical supply has a backup.
Backup is missing and deferral is not an admitted route.
A supply-only task must keep the functioning pump available.
A stop fails and the mission forbids returning a deferment as sufficient delivery.

uca_enumeration: Enumerate64 contexts: pump_running,critical_supply,backup,authority,stop_applied,entry_command; maintenance requested. Classify unsafe entry and continuity-breaking stop in actual context.

prior_amendment.reason: Separate potentially unsafe control contexts from realized material effects. Unexecuted initial source/freeze preserved; scenarios/acceptance unchanged.

amendment.reason: Controller receives current observation keys only. Actuator failure truth stays with the plant and is observed after a commanded stop; add separation/state-transition assertions.
